aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the video. 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, etc.
aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio

fast_mode.description: Speed up generation with different levels of acceleration. Faster modes may degrade quality somewhat. The speedup is dependent on the content, so different videos may see different speedups.
fast_mode.title: fast_mode

frames.description: The number of frames to generate (1 to 5 seconds)
frames.title: frames

image.description: Image to use as a starting frame for image to video generation.
image.title: Image

lora_strength_clip.description: Strength of the LORA applied to the CLIP model. 0.0 is no LORA.
lora_strength_clip.title: Lora Strength Clip

lora_strength_model.description: Strength of the LORA applied to the model. 0.0 is no LORA.
lora_strength_model.title: Lora Strength Model

lora_url.description: Optional: The URL of a LORA to use
lora_url.title: Lora Url

model.description: The model to use. 1.3b is faster, but 14b is better quality. A LORA either works with 1.3b or 14b, depending on the version it was trained on.
model.title: model

negative_prompt.description: Things you do not want to see in your video
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

resolution.description: The resolution of the video. 720p is not supported for 1.3b.
resolution.title: resolution

sample_guide_scale.description: Higher guide scale makes prompt adherence better, but can reduce variation
sample_guide_scale.title: Sample Guide Scale

sample_steps.description: Number of generation steps. Fewer steps means faster generation, at the expensive of output quality. 30 steps is sufficient for most prompts
sample_steps.title: Sample Steps

seed.description: Set a seed for reproducibility. Random by default.
seed.title: Seed
